parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The instance name. Fuzzy match is supported. For example, if you search for **abc**, all instances whose names contain **abc** may be returned, such as **abc**, **abcde**, **xyabc**, and **xabcy**.

parameters.name: instanceCategory
parameters.description: The edition of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the instance list.

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings the number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: vpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance.
